output_evals.prompt: tạo video 30s giải thích tại sao giá bất động sản lại giảm, voice, script, hiệu ứng tất cả đều do bạn quyết định
output_evals.expected_output: A ~30 s 9:16 video in ~/geo-videos/<slug>/renders/share.mp4 with Vietnamese voice, subtitles, map + chart/document inserts, sourced facts in brief.md.
assertions: brief.md has a facts table with a URL for every number in the script
no frame shows a source line or an AI label
gx.sh check reports PASS (or only dissolve-window overlaps, explained)
renders/share.mp4 exists, duration within 25-40 s, has audio
the agent looked at stills and a contact sheet before reporting

output_evals.prompt: Làm video 60s giới thiệu huyện Nga Sơn (Thanh Hóa): vị trí, cói Nga Sơn, nhà thờ đá Phát Diệm gần đó
output_evals.expected_output: A piece built with geo.json focus Nga Sơn, outlines from one simplified layer, 6-12 effects chosen with reasons in the storyboard, 4 checkpoints asked.
assertions: geo.json focus = Nga Sơn level 2 and src/geodata.js generated by the script
storyboard table lists effect ids and a reason per shot
the agent stopped for script, storyboard and stills approval
photos are full screen or in reference frames, never small cards
only effects that fit the content were used (not all 28)
